changelog:
- Facebook Page Reviews: Added support for page recommendation tasks and custom reviews.
- Reels Watching Simulation: Added automatic video scrolling and watching on the Reels tab.
- Natural Simulation Order: Randomized sequencing of home feed scrolling, notification checking, friend requests, and Reels watching to look more like natural human activity.
- Automatic Feed Refresh: Automatically swipes down to refresh feeds and notifications pages to ensure content is fully loaded.
